Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

Q: Understood. For the record, can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in my car, turning left off a main road in Houston, Texas, into a shpoping center driveway.
Q: What was the traffic like at the time?
A: It was fairly steady. There was a line of cars going the other way, and I had my turn signal on for a good while
before I moved.
Q: How did the ohter vehicle come into the picture?
A: The other car was coming straight down the road from the opposite direction. I started my turn when there was a
gap, and then it hit the front passenger side of my car.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not clearly. I glanced left and right, but it came up quickly, and I couldn't tell how fast it was going.
Q: Did you have any injuries?
A: Yes, my rihgt knee. It twisted against the dashboard and the pain got worse over the next day.
Q: Have you seen a doctor about the knee?
A: I went to urgent care the same evening, and I've had a follow-up since. They're still looking at it.
Q: Were there any passengers in your vehicle?
A: No, I was alone.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your account?
A: Only that I was trying to make the turn safely and I believe the damage to my car reflects where it was hit.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
